promotion_order: Archive PREVIOUS to the next free /old/NNN/ and never edit that archive again.
Promote verified LAB to CURRENT at /.
Keep /new/ as the development route for the next cycle.
archive_policy: Archives are immutable and as self-contained as practical; copy version-specific assets rather than depending on moving CURRENT/LAB assets.
git_policy: Before every write, read latest main; preserve unrelated concurrent changes; use a minimal non-force fast-forward commit; do not change application functionality solely for versioning.
